mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_outbox ( event_id, context_name, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, event_type, payload, trace_id, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, occurred_at, created_at, published_at, version ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{contextName}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{aggregateVersion}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSON), #{traceId}, 'NEW', 0, NULL, #{occurredAt}, #{createdAt}, NULL, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', next_retry_at = #{claimedUntil}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND ( status = 'NEW' OR (status IN ('FAILED', 'PROCESSING') AND next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) )
UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', next_retry_at = NULL, published_at = #{publishedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
